security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, CSS class names, design terminology, relative asset URLs, and legitimate local validation scripts. Confirmed issues are limited to remote template dependencies, public web image fetching, Mapbox network usage, and a curl-based asset workflow. Additional semantic review found token-handling and third-party package execution risks in the map and Live Photo workflows.

remediation.issue: Remote fonts and CDN script dependencies in seed templates
remediation.suggestion: Vendor fonts and icon scripts locally, or pin remote assets with integrity checks and document that rendering contacts external hosts.

remediation.issue: Mapbox token can be embedded in generated map image URLs
remediation.suggestion: Use scoped public tokens, avoid writing tokenized URLs to committed files, and strip or redact tokens from provenance files and final reports.

remediation.issue: Live Photo packaging executes third-party package code
remediation.suggestion: Pin makelive in every uvx example, require user confirmation before first install, and prefer a locked local environment for repeated use.

remediation.issue: Web-sourced image workflow can fetch untrusted external files
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit approval before web downloads, validate MIME type and size, keep files task-scoped, and retain source provenance.

remediation.issue: Binary WebP texture assets are not statically inspectable
remediation.suggestion: Track checksums and source notes for bundled binary assets, and re-review them when they change.

content.value_statement: Social posts often need strong visual structure, not just text on a canvas. This skill turns articles, screenshots, photos, and short videos into platform-ready card layouts.
actual_capabilities: Plans Rednote and Xiaohongshu carousel pages from articles, product notes, screenshots, subtitles, and photos.
Provides Editorial Magazine and Swiss International seed templates with fixed 3:4, 1:1, and 21:9 boards.
Guides WeChat Official Account cover pairs with a main 21:9 cover and a related 1:1 share card.
Supports short Live Photo card workflows, including single-video cards, grid puzzles, triple collages, and .pvt packaging notes.
Includes references for screenshot framing, image overlays, map components, title shortening, platform specs, and QA checks.
Includes a Playwright-based validator for overflow, footer collisions, font floors, density, title gaps, and other layout issues.
limitations: It needs local file access and rendering tools, so it is not useful in a chat-only environment.
Some seed templates and workflows use remote fonts, public image sources, map services, or third-party tooling.
Live Photo output depends on platform limits, local video tools, makelive, and an iPhone publishing path.
It is not intended for full slide decks, long-form video editing, pure photo retouching, or unsupported visual trends.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill target?

faq.question: Does it generate images by itself?
faq.answer: It can guide image generation, but its main value is layout planning, HTML composition, rendering, and QA around supplied or sourced assets.

faq.question: Can it use screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes screenshot framing rules, device chrome options, background treatments, and readability checks for UI or code captures.

faq.question: Can it make Live Photos?
faq.answer: It provides a workflow for short Live Photo cards and packaging notes, but publishing usually depends on local tools and an iPhone transfer path.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Not always, but templates and optional workflows may load fonts, icons, public images, map tiles, or third-party packages.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Users should provide the source text, target platform, preferred style, screenshots, photos, short clips, and any hard title or brand constraints.
